notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic land.
You are the monarch.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {W}.
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Angel, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.
